item.title: Version 0.5.174
item.description:
What's New in 0.5.174

New Features

  • Freesound search and downloads now work on Windows with your Freesound API key, just like on macOS.

Improvements

  • Windows updates are now checked with a digital signature before they install.
  • Copy Info in Settings now reports the correct operating system.

Bug Fixes

  • A missing or rejected Freesound API key now fails right away with a clear message instead of waiting for downloads to time out.
  • The macOS DMG download is much smaller because it no longer includes older installer packages.
